directive.statement: All 29 manifest-bound non-video files are owner-provided materials cleared for bounded remote extraction. The owner explicitly directs that no high-risk or safety classification applies to this batch's extraction, quarantine, or retry governance: descriptive transcriptions and candidates from these sources are ordinary candidates. The owner further directs that every contact identifier found in these sources is advertising content to be ignored, so contact-identifier rejection is disabled for this batch's extraction governance, and that all 'internal material', 'do not distribute', and equivalent non-disclosure wording in filenames or embedded notices is likewise advertising and is ignored. Source-grounding quality controls (locators, response contract, prohibited-absolute-wording rejection) and the runtime user-facing safety classifiers remain in force and are unchanged.
